Data Inspection: lv, na, check_system

Source: vignettes/data_inspection.Rmd
data_inspection.Rmd

lv() — Variable Summary

lv() provides a quick overview of variables in a data frame (or Seurat object). It invisibly returns the original data. In a knitted document, use results = "asis" so the native report tables render directly.

library(UtilsR)

# All variables
lv(iris)
Variable Summary

na() — Missing Value Analysis 

# Create data with NAs
df <- data.frame(
  x = c(1, NA, 3, NA, 5),
  y = c("a", "b", NA, "d", "e"),
  z = 1:5
)
check_na(df)
#> ======   ℹ Data quality analysis: 2 variables with data quality issues ℹ   =====
Missing & Special Value Analysis
Dataset: 5 observations, 3 variables, 2 variables with missing values, 0 variables with special values

check_system() — System Diagnostics 

check_system()

Reports OS, R version, memory, CPU info, and loaded packages.

check_size() — Object Memory Profiling 

check_size()

Shows memory usage of all objects in the global environment, even when called inside a function. Pass envir = environment() to inspect the calling function’s objects instead, and method = "lobstr" for a total that counts storage shared between objects once.
